title: Healthcare Staff by State and Staff Type
description: Number of public sector healthcare staff at national and state level, with a breakdown by staff type.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 16 states, or Malaysia for national-level data

fields.name: staff_type
fields.title: Staff Type
fields.description: [Categorical] Either doctors ('doctor'), nurses ('nurse'), community nurses ('nurse_community'), dentists ('dentist'), or all staff ('all')

methodology: This dataset is tabulated from the operational individual-level records maintained by the Health Informatics Centre (PIK) of the Ministry of Health. The data reflects the number of active healthcare staff as at 31 December each year.
